exposure: maternal anemia during pregnancy (measured by Hb values in first and second trimesters)
cohort: The study included 801 pregnant women (267 cases with preterm birth and 534 controls) from Sardashat, Iran.
finding: Maternal anemia during pregnancy was significantly associated with an increased risk of preterm birth (aOR = 2.69; 95% CI: 1.46 to 4.95), even after adjusting for confounders.
